verdict.rationale: Manufact's dashboard exposes a Gateway Requests observability view showing individual request events (volume) with optional payload capture, and org-level spend limits/billing exist, but the evidence never explicitly documents error-rate metrics, per-user usage breakdowns, or cost attributed per server/tool — only raw event logs and org billing. Missing for 10: dedicated error/failure metrics, per-user consumer analytics, and per-server/tool cost breakdown tied to usage rather than org-wide billing.
